name: 家用双层压纹厨房纸巾提装款

category.leaf: 双层压纹厨房纸巾提装

description: 满版主张色与线性图标宫格，原木台面压纹展开与吸液微距，航拍林地印章收口

styleLock.direction: value household-paper commerce with flat infographic panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF cyclorama for packshots, full-bleed signal orange #EE6C1A and pale peach #FBE7DC flat fields for the infographic screens, warm oak butcher-block #D8B285 for counter screens, deep forest green #1F4A3A aerial field for the trust close
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light with a broad front-left key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows, no hard speculars; counter screens lit by soft daylight from the left at 5200K, canopy screen under even overcast top light at 6000K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm oak butcher-block counter #D8B285 with visible grain for touch screens, matte pale board #EFE3D6 for macro screens, flat colour fields elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy display headline band plus one light sub-line, copy only inside reserved blank bands and rounded white plates
styleLock.iconSystem: single-family thin-line outline glyphs in #EE6C1A, uniform 6pt stroke, flat 2D, no fill, no gradient, no shading
styleLock.presentationRules: packs upright with the roll tops reading as one level row; a torn sheet always spread flat with the fold crease visible; both panels of any split screen share identical angle, crop, scale and light
noDrift: no invented numerals, units, ratio marks or badge artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent value household-paper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of signal orange #EE6C1A, pale peach #FBE7DC, clean white #FFFFFF and deep forest green #1F4A3A with a warm oak surface #D8B285; warm high-key studio lighting with broad front-left key, bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one heavy display headline band; single-family thin-line outline icon set in #EE6C1A only; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels and blank label plates; stable slight 3/4 pack angle and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用前后错位的两包提装坐实家庭量贩的第一印象。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, two carry packs one behind the other, whole group inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, broad front-left key with a large fill card, soft contact shadows under both packs
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, a clear floor margin keeps both packs off the frame edges
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce product hero packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two shrink-wrapped multi-packs stand one behind the other, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn so the front face and one side read together, roll tops forming one level row, the whole group inside the frame with nothing cropped. Bright even high-key studio lighting, broad front-left key with a large fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both packs on seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond a clear floor margin. Square 1:1, 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no legible package lettering, no badge or certification artwork, no cut-off edges, no floating packs without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 开篇第二镜锁定预期，用同框双卡说明外装焕新而内物不变，降低到货落差退货。
shots.camera: dead-on frontal flat graphic plane, two rounded cards side by side at identical height and identical crop
shots.lighting: even flat panel light, soft contact shadow inside each card, no directional drama
shots.props: two rounded white #FFFFFF card plates at equal size
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top 24% for the headline band
shots.textZone: 顶部 24% 纯色留白带供一行主张「{selling_point_1}」，两卡下方各一枚空白标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce packaging-transition comparison screen, dead-on frontal view of a flat graphic plane. Two matched rounded white #FFFFFF cards sit side by side at identical height and identical crop, each holding one shrink-wrapped multi-pack of {product} photographed straight-on at eye level, the left pack in a blank muted sleeve #D9CFC4 and the right pack in a blank brighter sleeve #F3A266 so the pair reads as an earlier and a newer outer wrap of the very same item, never as two different goods. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat panel lighting with one soft contact shadow inside each card, full-bleed signal orange #EE6C1A field. The two cards together occupy 50-60% of the frame with clean negative space held across the top 24%. Square 1:1. Negative: no brand wordmarks, no legible package lettering, no competitor logo or rival product, no tick or cross marks, no arrow callouts, no invented numerals, no dense body text.

shots.displayName: 线性图标四宫格卖点板
shots.intent: 一秒把四条核心卖点压成可扫读的图标矩阵，承上启下进入证据段。
shots.camera: dead-on frontal flat graphic plane, glyphs on a two by two grid
shots.lighting: flat even light with no shadow falloff, glyph strokes kept crisp
shots.props: four thin-line outline glyph frames with empty label rows beneath
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 22% and even gutters between the four cells
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白带供「{selling_point_2}」，四格下方各一行空白标签位供「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit grid screen, dead-on frontal view of a flat graphic plane on a pale peach #FBE7DC field. {product} appears only as four thin-line outline glyphs set in a two by two grid: a stacked-sheets glyph, a droplet glyph, a torn-edge glyph and a rolled-sheet glyph with dashed perforation ticks, every stroke uniform in a single thin weight and drawn in signal orange #EE6C1A with no fill and no shading. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat even lighting with no shadow falloff so the strokes stay crisp. The glyph block occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the top 22% and even gutters between cells. Square 1:1. Negative: no invented numerals or units, no legible labels, no filled or gradient icons, no photographic props, no badge artwork, no mixed icon weights, no clutter in the headline band.

shots.displayName: 原木台面压纹单张展开
shots.intent: 把单张摊开在食物级木台上，用折痕与压纹点证明纸面结构而非口头宣称。
shots.camera: photographed from above at a high 45-degree angle looking down the spread sheet, far edge higher in frame
shots.lighting: soft daylight from the left at 5200K with a low skimming sweep across the surface relief, one gentle shadow under the lifted near corner
shots.background: warm oak butcher-block counter #D8B285 with visible grain
shots.whitespace: clean negative space in the upper-left corner reserved for one rounded plate
shots.textZone: 左上圆角留白卡位供「{callout_5}」，其余区域不放字
shots.promptTemplate: Material detail shot of one sheet torn from {product}, spread open across a warm oak butcher-block counter #D8B285 with the fold crease running down the middle and the blank embossed dot pattern catching the light, photographed from above at a high 45-degree angle so the far edge sits higher in the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft daylight from the left at 5200K with a low skimming sweep over the surface relief and one gentle shadow under the lifted near corner. No props. The sheet detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with clean negative space in the upper-left corner reserved for one rounded white #FFFFFF plate. Square 1:1. Negative: no legible embossed lettering, no water marks or stains on the counter, no hands, no invented sheet-count numerals, no plastic-looking fibre, no duplicated grain pattern.

shots.intent: 微距锁住干纸、湿纸与压纹交界的一线，让吸收这件事被看见而不是被说出。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a very low angle skimming the surface, shallow depth of field, foreground line sharp
shots.lighting: low skimming light from the right revealing fibre relief, one controlled highlight, soft shadow behind
shots.whitespace: minimal, the fibre texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the saturated edge of a sheet from {product}, tight zoom on the line where dry fibre, darkened wet fibre and the blank embossed dots meet, photographed from a very low angle skimming along the surface with shallow depth of field and the foreground line sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low skimming light from the right revealing fibre relief with one controlled highlight and a soft shadow behind, background a matte pale board #EFE3D6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace since the texture is the subject. Square 1:1. Negative: no blurry subject, no dirt or lint clumps, no mould, no insects or contamination, no droplets arranged in a fake grid, no invented lab readouts, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.displayName: 木台泼洒随手擦拭场景
shots.intent: 把纸放回清晨咖啡泼洒的真实台面，让买家代入自己家的那一张桌子。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level over the table, table surface filling the lower two thirds, background thrown soft
shots.lighting: soft daylight from the left at 5200K with warm bounce off the oak, one contact shadow under the bunched sheet
shots.background: warm oak kitchen table #D8B285 against a blurred pale wall
shots.props: one cup on a saucer at the left edge and one out-of-focus pot silhouette behind, neither covering the sheet
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the upper left reserved for one rounded plate
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: a generic hand pressing a bunched sheet torn from {product} onto a small liquid spill on a warm oak kitchen table #D8B285, the sheet edge visibly darkening where it wicks the liquid, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle with the table surface filling the lower two thirds. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft daylight from the left at 5200K with warm bounce off the oak and one contact shadow under the sheet, background a blurred pale wall. Props: one cup on a saucer at the left edge and one out-of-focus pot silhouette behind, neither covering the sheet. The action occupies 40-50% of the frame with clean negative space across the upper left reserved for one rounded white #FFFFFF plate. Negative: no visible face, no more than one hand, no deformed or fused fingers, no liquid on skin, no grimy or unsanitary context, no legible package lettering, no invented absorbency figures.

shots.intent: 用两行线性卷筒示意图把幅面差异画成可比的结构问题，替买家消除规格疑虑。
shots.camera: dead-on frontal graphic plane, two schematic rows stacked with a shared left margin
shots.lighting: flat even light with no shadow, strokes kept clean
shots.props: two thin-line roll schematics with unspooled bands and dashed perforation ticks
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 26% and even gaps between the two rows
shots.textZone: 顶部 26% 留白带供「{selling_point_4}」，两行左侧各一行空白标签位供「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce specification infographic, dead-on frontal view of a flat graphic plane. {product} is represented only by two thin-line roll schematics stacked one above the other in signal orange #EE6C1A, each drawn as a cylinder seen from a slight top angle with an unspooled band carrying dashed perforation ticks, both bands starting from one shared left margin and running to clearly different lengths so the pair reads as a comparison of span, not of quality. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat even lighting with no shadow on a pale peach #FBE7DC field. The two schematic rows occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the top 26% and even gaps between rows. Square 1:1. Negative: no numerals, no units, no equals or multiplication signs, no ratio claims, no competitor silhouette, no legible labels, no filled shapes or gradients, no ruler graduations.

shots.intent: 以航拍针叶林与一枚空白印章框收口，把原料出身讲成可信但不可造假的视觉证据。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle across the canopy, one seal plate centred
shots.lighting: even overcast top light at 6000K giving soft relief to the canopy, one thin contact shadow under the plate's lower edge
shots.background: dense aerial conifer canopy in deep forest green #1F4A3A filling the whole frame
shots.props: one blank rounded white #FFFFFF seal plate with nothing inside
shots.whitespace: canopy margin on all four sides, no extra whitespace inside the plate
shots.textZone: 中央圆角空白印章框，内部不出现任何字样、注册号或角标图形
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle across a dense conifer canopy in deep forest green #1F4A3A that fills the whole frame, one clean rounded white #FFFFFF plate centred over it as an empty origin seal frame reserved for {product}, with nothing drawn inside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even overcast top light at 6000K giving soft relief to the treetops and one thin contact shadow under the plate's lower edge so it reads as resting above the canopy. Canopy and plate read at 40-50% of the frame with canopy margin on all four sides. Square 1:1. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, registry codes, audit numbers, seal artwork or check-tree glyphs; no legible text, no watermark, no stock-photo mark, no duplicated tree pattern, no colour cast on the plate.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：第一张白底两包提装卷纸前后错位、卷顶一排齐平；第二张高饱和主张色满版加两枚圆角白卡的新旧外装告知页，顶部粗体大字带；第三张淡桃底四枚线性图标宫格（叠层、液滴、撕边、卷筒虚线）；第四张淡桃底两行线性卷筒展开示意，虚线分档刻度、长短两档；第五张单张纸在原木台面摊开、中部折痕与压纹点清晰、左上圆角留白卡；第六张一只手把纸按在木台泼洒液渍上、纸边吸液变深、背景虚化壶具与杯；第七张航拍针叶林满版加中央圆角空白印章框。品类判定依据：画面全部为卷状吸液纸在厨房台面的摊开、擦拭与规格图示，非贴身如厕卷筒纸也非盒装面巾纸，故判 L1 家居日用 / L2 纸品清洁 / leaf 双层压纹厨房纸巾提装，与源提示类目一致无需改判。与库内既有同类厨房纸巾卷款的区分：本款独有分镜为新旧外装双卡告知页、四宫格线性图标卖点板、线性卷幅换算示意页与航拍林地空白印章信任页，视觉体系为满版主张色加淡桃底线性图示，而非实景草绿版面；白底提装主图与台面吸液镜两度出现属同类目共用镜头，第八镜吸液边缘微距由第五、六镜的纸面与吸液瞬间拆解补写。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列字样、外装印刷上的品名与规格行数、倍数换算与每卷张数与幅面尺寸类数量断言、林管类认证字标与注册号、原平台店铺与角标字样、全部图内英文标题原句与强调色文字；上述断言一律不入稿，图内文字只留「{selling_point_n}」「{callout_n}」占位或空白标签位、空白印章框与无刻度示意，四枚图标仅为通用字形不构成层级、强度或掉屑率主张，场景手部为无身份 generic hand。
